lead: A small server of black cat enjoyers who mostly hang out in Bongo Cat. Grab the lobby code, vote on this week's Friday Dress Code, and pet the cat while you're here.

taps.label: Taps and pets on the lobby cat

join.title: Join the server first
join.general: You're logged in, but not in our Discord server yet. Voting, birthdays, member profiles and the lobby cat's progress are for people in the server.
join.members: The member list is for people in our Discord server. Join it and everyone here shows up.
join.birthdays: You see the public birthdays. Join the server to add your own, get reminders and see everyone's.
join.voting: Voting on the Friday Dress Code is for people in our Discord server.
join.note: It updates by itself a few minutes after you join.
